title: Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes
description: Find the length of the shortest path that visits every node in an undirected graph.
pseudocode:
1. queue = [[i, 1 << i] for i in range(n)]
2. dist = [[-1] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
3. while queue:
4.   node, mask = queue.pop(0)
5.   if mask == (1 << n) - 1: return dist[node][mask]
6.   for neighbor in graph[node]:
7.     new_mask = mask | (1 << neighbor)
8.     if dist[neighbor][new_mask] == -1:
9.       queue.push([neighbor, new_mask])

steps.note: Initialize queue with all nodes and their starting bitmask states.
Pop the current node and mask state from the BFS queue.
Update bitmask to indicate node 1 has been visited.
Push new state [1, 3] to queue for further exploration.
